children: AMPERA, Inc. announced on Tuesday a
with special purpose acquisition company Berto Acquisition
that values AMPERA at approximately $900M on a pre-money equity basis.

The transaction is expected to deliver up to $357M in gross cash proceeds, assuming no redemptions by Berto’s public shareholders, comprising roughly $317M from Berto’s trust account, over $30M from a common stock PIPE financing, and $10M  in pre-closing equity and debt commitments.
The parties are also in discussions for an incremental $50M to $100M in additional PIPE capital.

Existing backers and PIPE subscribers include a leading AI data center equipment provider, a major quantum computing company, a global maritime firm, a U.S. defense contractor, and a Middle East industrial investor.

AMPERA develops factory-built, modular power systems centered on its proprietary supercritical carbon dioxide (sCO₂) power conversion cycle (sPower™). Its near-term PowerNOW™ lineup targets commercial deliveries starting in Q4 2027 with natural-gas and waste-heat systems ranging from 7.5MW to 45MW, while its longer-term NuclearNEXT™ program is developing a 15MW thorium-fueled, subcritical reactor designed for a 30-year core life without routine refueling.
Upon closing, expected in Q1 2027, the combined entity will operate as AMPERA, Inc. and list on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol AMPR.
Proceeds will fund platform development and initial commercial scale-up.

title: AMPERA to go public via $900M SPAC merger with Berto Acquisition Corp.
